summary: Iteration 9: tested the watched-course bonus XP, course badge share card and the My courses page, on both backend and frontend. Backend: 8 of 8 pytest tests pass. They cover the progress API structure, auth (401), the empty state, a +100 bonus paid exactly once with the 'Course bonus' activity and xp=100, no bonus when the completion came before watching (done=true, done_after_watch=false), the bonus being applied through /api/dashboard, no double pay when 6 requests run in parallel (unique index), no repay after unwatch + rewatch, the share-card 404 before watching, a 1200x627 PNG, HTML with og:title/og:image and a redirect to /u/{username}, 404 for a bad token or an unwatched course, and the demo student having the bonus already paid. Frontend E2E with a fresh student: nav-my-courses goes to /app/courses and shows the empty state. Browse goes to /courses. Marking 585979 as watched works. Before the flag the page shows 'Finish any matching item...', 0/3 done, and Kali/SIEM marked PRACTICE TOOL. The ctf-net item link goes to /app/ctf. Solving ctf-net-2 and going back to My courses shows the toast '+100 XP course bonus: ...', the bonus earned and 1/3 done. XP went from 0 to 200 (flag 100 + bonus 100). The share dialog image loads at 1200x627. The LinkedIn href is share-offsite with an encoded share_url. The download href points to the .png. Copy shows the 'Link copied' toast. No console errors.

minor.issue: The dashboard calls courses_progress and pays the bonus silently without returning 'awarded'. A student who opens the dashboard first (the default landing page) never sees the '+100 XP course bonus' toast, because My courses later returns awarded []. Only the activity feed shows it.
Each resubmission overwrites report_at. Resubmitting an old lab report after watching a course counts as 'completed after watch' and pays the bonus without new work.

issues: The 'practice tool' label (text-slate-500, 10px) has low contrast on the dark card, which is minor.

action_items: Optional: return 'awarded' from /api/dashboard (or keep an unseen flag in course_bonus) so the bonus toast also appears on the dashboard
Optional: only set report_at on the first report submission so resubmitting doesn't trigger the bonus
critical_code_review_comments: The Wireshark course title contains 'Kali', so it also matches the Kali rule and gets 5 items (ctf-net, kali, siem, lab-brute, ctf-for) instead of the 3 in the review request. This is expected given RULES, but check it is what you intend.
courses_progress runs 1 + N*items DB queries per call and runs on every dashboard load. That is fine at the current scale (100 courses max).
seed_data_creation: Test users (test_bonus_*, tui_*) were created and then deleted, along with their completions, bonus records, ctf_solves and activity
context_for_next_testing_agent: The activity collection is 'activity' (not 'activities'). pytest.ini adds xdist flags (-n), so don't pass -p no:xdist. Course 585979 matches both the wireshark and kali rules. CTF flags: ctf-net-1 SOCF{60}, ctf-net-2 SOCF{3389}. For a fresh user, register and then call /api/auth/onboarding {goal:'SOC L1'}.
